comparison.objective: Extract a terminal, versus thread and tighten an oil filter to a specified post-contact angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Tab release and linear withdrawal, versus thread engagement and bounded rotary tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Undamaged isolated terminal removal; versus gasket contact followed by the permitted turn range without cross-threading or overtightening.
comparison.reason: The record tests threaded rotary assembly, not recessed latch release.
